The wearer's boss entitlement authorizes this commission; the artisan need not have killed Sapphiron.
candidates.unlock: One durable, non-tradable blueprint entitlement per character and canonical Sapphiron encounter family, awarded only after an eligible raid participant contributes and the encounter is won. mechanic.trigger: A direct, non-periodic Frost damage event from a qualifying hostile NPC hits the wearer while this exact shield is equipped.
mechanic.effect: Grant the wearer one self-only shield that absorbs the next direct hostile damage event within 6 seconds, equal to 2% of maximum health, capped at 1,000 damage. It expires unused and cannot stack with another copy.
mechanic.empty_behavior: The +8 Frost Resistance passive remains while this exact shield is equipped. Only the signature absorb is unavailable at zero charges; recharge restores charges, never the passive.

reusable_tools: City Enchanting Station (facility; reused, not consumed)

stages.name: Eligibility, blueprint, and relic custody review

candidates.teaching: An optional, named apprentice with real Enchanting training may take part in a recorded stage and receive one noncombat lesson credit after this useful project completes. It grants no native skill, XP, item, combat effect, or blueprint entitlement.
candidates.maker_reward: Proposed custom signature mastery: award the lead artisan one noncombat credit per distinct useful completed project, keyed to design, wearer, original host-item GUID, and durable project ID. Retries, reshipments, or reapplying this same finish cannot duplicate it; no native XP/skill or combat stat is granted, and no global trait cap is added.
bot_rules: Count only continuously observed eligible Enchanting-450 artisan minutes at the assigned safe city station, with reservations and custody verified; pause on logout, outage, combat, absence, danger, disconnect, or uncertainty. Never catch up on login or carry excess time.

Persist project/stage/event identity, wearer, exact host-item GUID, charges, and ICD. Reconcile before restart-resume; deduplicate callbacks. Charges and cooldown follow the item through relog, death, swap, bank, mail, and trade; active effects end on expiry or normal unequip/death/logout cleanup without free reset.
abuse_rules: The blueprint and one consumed relic are tied to the named canonical raid encounter; after acquisition, the signature works against qualifying genuine hostile NPCs generally, including world and other-raid targets. Exclude PvP, friendly/self/environment, periodic/reflected/item/proc/legacy sources, pets/summons, encounter adds, trivial grey targets, probes, dummies, and admin fixtures.

Require a unique direct event and genuine combat-credit NPC (at least wearer level minus 5, or an elite/rare/boss). One charge per resolved event; no recursion, duplicate callback, friend target, add loop, or reset through death/relog/equipment changes.
The 30-charge item capacity and stated ICD bound this mechanic only; there is no global earned-trait or loadout cap.
dependencies: Exact shield host, replacement channel, Frost Resistance property, absorb behavior, save/load, item custody, and event source all need separate native/custom route review and observation. No native ID, recipe, item, drop, proc, or live unlock is admitted.
This enchant awards no boss-legacy +5%/+10% primary attributes and does not duplicate or alter Sapphiron's separate boss trait; no such reward is issued by this design.
The final real native craft must remain authoritative for material consumption/output and any ordinary profession XP. Timer progress and custom maker credit grant no native progression.
